interpretation: Document presence, proposed engineering depth, implementation and independently accepted evidence are separate axes. Detailed-bounded-design describes the documented in-process scope only, not complete adapters or production approval. This appraisal is not an acceptance registry or an alternate execution queue.

acceptance_rule: Use the existing retained-evidence and independent-review contracts. Editing a depth label never closes a gap or changes product gates.
